meta.promptText: I want to buy running shoes under ₹3000 in India. Which ones should I get?

response.text:

My first choice would be a Decathlon running shoe for value, followed by a Puma or ASICS model if you find one on sale. Prices vary by size, colour, and seller, so treat these as a shortlist rather than guaranteed deals.

search_results.title: I ran 35 miles in the Saucony Hurricane 26 - here's my reasons to buy (and skip)
search_results.description:
The Saucony Hurricane 26, launched in summer 2026 at $170, is an upgraded stability running shoe designed for comfort and daily training. It features a new IncrediLux midsole foam core surrounded by PWRRUN foam, enhancing softness, bounce, and reducing overall weight to 9.7oz. With a 6mm drop and a maximum stack height, it's lighter and more supportive than its predecessor, the Hurricane 25. The upper focuses on comfort with ample padding, though it may trap heat. A firm, grippy rubber outsole ensures durability without harshness.

While not ideal for speed workouts due to its wide profile and clunky feel at higher paces, it's excellent for easy long runs and recovery days. It offers subtle but effective stability suitable even for neutral runners seeking extra support. Compared to alternatives like the Asics Gel-Kayano 33 and Nike Structure Plus, it's plusher and smoother in ride. The Hoka Arahi 9, however, may suit those prioritizing lighter, more versatile stability shoes. Overall, the Hurricane 26 is a top pick for those seeking plush comfort and reliable support in a stability shoe, justifying its premium price for the right user.

search_results.title: 15 best affordable Asics running shoe deals with up to 56% off - including the Novablast 5, Gel-Kayano and more
search_results.description: Tom’s Guide highlights 15 top Asics running shoe deals, with discounts reaching up to 56% off, making it an ideal time for runners to nab quality footwear at lower prices. Featured models include the Asics Gel-Kayano 30 (56% off, now $69), praised for stability and cushioning, especially for overpronators. The Novablast 5, formerly ranked as the best running shoe, is now $129, recognized for its comfort and springy ride. Women can grab the Novablast 4 for just $67, and other standout deals include the Glideride Max ($170 to $80), GT-1000 14 ($110 to $79), and Gel-Cumulus 27 ($140 to $89). Models suited for road and trail running are also included, such as the Fuji Lite 6 trail shoes ($130 to $99). Each shoe offers specific benefits—such as energy-saving features, lightweight builds, and strong traction—catering to various running needs. Shoppers are advised that prices may vary based on size and color. Whether for casual jogging or performance training, this guide ensures quality choices at budget-friendly prices for runners of all levels.

search_results.title: Asics Prime Day deals are turning walkers into runners: Put a 'pep in my step'
search_results.description: During Amazon's October Prime Day—also known as Prime Big Deal Days—ASICS running shoes, such as the Gel-Excite 11, have become a standout product, inspiring even non-runners to get active. Priced under $75, these sneakers feature soft cushioning and GEL technology for superior comfort and support. Commerce Journalist Victoria McConnell praises their lightweight feel and springy bounce, noting they’ve motivated her to exercise more frequently. Many customers echo her sentiments, highlighting ASICS as both supportive and stylish for walking and running alike. The article also mentions other top sneaker deals, including New Balance FuelCell, Nike Air Max Excee, and ALLSWIFIT’s slip-on sneakers, all highly rated for comfort and performance. October Prime Day runs from October 6–7, 2026, and is exclusive to Amazon Prime members, who can sign up for a 30-day free trial to access the sale. This event offers early holiday discounts on tech, fashion, and household essentials before Black Friday and Cyber Monday. Shoppers are encouraged to take advantage of these limited-time deals.
